note: Barbados, read on the Immigration Department's own work permit page on 2026-10-30. A long-term work permit is valid for up to 3 years, applied for by the employer or 'sponsor' on the employee's behalf (read as work for the sponsor, and as applied for before the work, from abroad), once the employer shows that no resident or Barbadian can fill the post. The application fee is BBD 300 (kept); the final fee varies with the category of work and the length of time asked, which the form doesn't hold. Short-term permits (up to eleven months) aren't written. The CARICOM skills certificate (free movement of skilled nationals), permanent residence and naturalisation weren't read on the Department's site and aren't written.

sources.title: Barbados Immigration Department, Work Permit
sources.said: Short-Term work permits are valid for a period up to eleven months. The employer or 'sponsor' has the responsibility to make the application on behalf of the employee. ... Long-Term Work Permits are valid for a period of up to 3 years . ... NB: THE APPLICATION FEE IS $300.00 BDS BUT THE FINAL FEE WILL VARY DEPENDENT ON THE CATEGORY OF WORK AND THE LENGTH OF TIME REQUESTED
